usedFor: Shopify holds shoppers, and Veeqo adds them as customers for inventory and orders through “Create Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Customer” in Veeqo
bestTemplate.why: The checkout carries an email and phone, and the action takes email, contact details and customer type.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so a customer reaches Veeqo after a scheduled check.
